$comment: Spec 1967, Wire Contract section 11: the shared test vectors for protocol 1. Each case is what R must decide at steps 1 to 8 of section 5 (step 8 never fails here: every case has its own statementId). verdict is verified, not-verified, or refused with the reason (steps 3 and 7). The Tower runs this file unchanged; Codev Cloud runs a copy. Byte values are base64url without padding; times are epoch ms.
